diagnosis: All four rollouts successfully revealed both PF1 and PF2 and cited them in justification_fact_ids, so disclosure is not the problem. The gate failed due to two distinct failure modes. First, ENCODING MISMATCH on C9 and C10: these checks failed in all four rollouts (tally 0/4 each) despite the settlements containing commitments that functionally satisfy PF1's assignment-consent requirement and PF2's segregated-reserve requirement — the models used commitment type strings like "consent_package", "closing_condition", "segregated_account", "operating_condition", and "closing_control", none of which apparently match the exact type or field name C9 and C10 expect. Second, on C8 in rollout 3, A2 reinterpreted PF1's unconditional consent-package requirement as conditional (only needed if KITE/NORTHSTAR invoices are included), and the settlement followed that reinterpretation by setting assignment_consent_package_required to false — a disclosure problem where subsequent conversation undermined the revealed fact rather than a check wording issue, since C8 passed in the other three rollouts where the field was set to true.
